title: Rollout State Transitions Chronicle: compact timeline + rollback inspector
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, narratable representation of rollout state transitions that helps operators understand incremental percentage shifts, segment-level metrics, and rollback options at a glance. The concept — "flipbook" timeline cards + an inline rollback inspector — is intended to live on the Rollouts detail page and support canaries, A/B experiments, and staged releases. The goal is to reduce cognitive load when triaging gradual rollouts and to shorten the time to safe rollback without sacrificing auditability.
goals: Make rollout state history scannable across 6-12 steps without vertical scroll
Surface segment-level KPIs (latency P95, error rate, cost delta) aligned to each step
Enable one-click rollback with contextual reasoning and a dry-run simulator
Support keyboard navigation and motion-reduced mode for accessibility
user_stories: As a platform engineer, I want to quickly scan the last N rollout steps so I can decide whether to pause or rollback
As a PM, I want to compare two states and see metric deltas so I can validate hypothesis-driven A/B changes
As an incident responder, I want an emergency rollback path that shows expected impact and required steps
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates a horizontal flipbook of up to 12 states with thumbnails and expanded detail pane
Each state shows timestamp, percentage allocation, top 3 metrics, and a compact changelog line
Rollback inspector surfaces predicted impact, dependency checklist, and links to related traces/dashboards
Design includes motion-reduced variant and keyboard shortcuts documented
Figma prototype linked and validated in two 30-minute stakeholder walkthroughs
comments: 2026-02-28 - Aisha Patel: Initial concept synched with PM and Eng. Decided to try compact horizontal flipbook rather than a tall vertical stack to keep rollouts scannable when many steps exist.

2026-03-03 - Liam O'Connor: Engineering feasibility review — ENG flagged concern about rendering 12 live metric mini-charts in the client. Proposal: thumbnails show aggregated KPIs and lazy-load detailed charts in the inspector pane.
2026-03-05 - PM (Rafael Gomez): Suggested adding a simulated dry-run for rollback that estimates traffic and cost deltas. Marked as high value for enterprise customers with SLAs.
2026-03-06 - Design critique: Accessibility comment — ensure contrast and provide a motion-reduced interaction. Also add focus outline for keyboard users navigating between states.

2026-03-08 - UX Research (Maya Lin): Ran 5 moderated sessions with platform engineers. Observations: users loved the quick compare mode, but requested clearer indicators for 'partial rollback' vs 'full rollback'. Added microcopy changes.
2026-03-10 - Liam O'Connor: Dev update — implemented mock API for state diffs and a sandboxed dry-run endpoint. Performance tests show acceptable frame rates when thumbnails are static SVGs.

2026-03-11 - Aisha Patel: Updated Figma to include rollback inspector with checklist and required approvals. Added copy for explainability hints: 'Why this rollback? Top contributing signals: error-rate + latency spike.'

2026-03-12 - Security review (DevSecOps): Quick scan — no new data surfaces beyond existing rollout audit logs. Recommended adding an audit entry when rollback is executed via the inspector. Marking follow-up for ENG-22488.

2026-03-13 - Design handoff: Preparing tokens, CSS vars, and interaction spec. Next: pair with ENG to prototype keyboard accessibility and motion-reduced toggles in staging. Requesting review from PM and Eng leads.
decisions: Use horizontal flipbook with thumbnails + detail inspector (decision made 2026-02-28)
Lazy-load metric mini-charts to preserve performance (decision made 2026-03-03)
Include dry-run simulator in rollback inspector as an opt-in step (decision made 2026-03-05)
Add audit-log write on rollback trigger (action item for ENG-22488, noted 2026-03-12)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Visual density could overwhelm users — Mitigation: progressive disclosure, 3-metric thumbnail limit
Risk: Motion/animation could cause accessibility issues — Mitigation: motion-reduced mode and prefer transforms over layout changes
Risk: Misleading rollback predictions — Mitigation: label dry-run estimates clearly and include confidence bands
next_steps: Eng + Design pairing session to implement keyboard nav (owner: Liam, due: 2026-03-18)
Add audit log call and QA tests for rollback action (owner: ENG-22488, due: 2026-03-22)
Pilot feature with two internal teams; gather metrics on time-to-rollback (owner: PM, due: 2026-04-07)
